purpose: A 3D Slicer scripted module that segments 15 abdominal organs in CT with the SlimFormer++ network (nnU-Net v2 pre/post-processing), aimed at research users who want CPU-capable abdominal organ segmentation inside Slicer.
summary: Well-structured, honest extension: no telemetry, weights downloaded from the author's GitHub releases with SHA256 verification, `torch.load(..., weights_only=True)`, zip path-traversal checks, inference in a separate PythonSlicer process with cancel support, and PyTorch/nnU-Net installed only through the PyTorch and NNUNet extensions after a confirmation dialog. Catalog entry, CMake file list and EXTENSION_DEPENDS are consistent. Main issue: `_ensurePandasMatchesNumpy()` silently runs `slicer.util.pip_install("pandas<3.1")` — a pin/downgrade of a shared package with no user confirmation, on a path that runs even when nothing is missing. Licensing is clear but noncommercial for model.py/weights, and the license text is not installed into the package. Recommend 🔴 Do not merge yet until the silent pip install is removed or gated.
